estimates.name: Changes in Financial Condition — General
estimates.t: Total assets as of September 30, 2026 were $2.952 billion compared to $2.425 billion as of December 31, 2025.

estimates.name: Other Assets
estimates.t: Other assets as of September 30, 2026 were $10.2 million compared to $8.4 million as of December 31, 2025.

estimates.name: Securities
estimates.t: The fair value of securities available for sale as of September 30, 2026 was $429.5 million compared to $408.8 million as of December 31, 2025.

estimates.name: Loans

estimates.effect: The Company had net charge-offs for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 of $2.6 million, compared to $1.3 million in the corresponding period in 2025.

estimates.name: Deposits
estimates.t: During the nine-months ended September 30, 2026, total deposits increased $430.3 million due primarily to a $162.2 million increase in certificates of deposit, a $105.9 million increase in interest-bearing demand deposits, and a $162.2 million increase in all other deposit categories.

estimates.name: Borrowings
estimates.t: The Company had $56.1 million in short-term borrowings at September 30, 2026, compared to $14.7 million at December 31, 2025.
